excerpt.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]的时候，我们发现了一种怪异的岩石形态，矗立在这颗本以为空无一物的荒凉行星上。
excerpt.en: While surveying [From.GetName], we uncovered a grotesque rock formation from what has been thought to be nothing but a barren planet.

texts.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]的时候，我们发现了一种怪异的岩石形态，矗立在这颗本以为空无一物的荒凉行星上。
texts.en: While surveying [From.GetName], we uncovered a grotesque rock formation from what has been thought to be nothing but a barren planet.

sections.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]的时候，我们发现了一种怪异的岩石形态，矗立在这颗本以为空无一物的荒凉行星上。
sections.en: While surveying [From.GetName], we uncovered a grotesque rock formation from what has been thought to be nothing but a barren planet.

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]的进一步探索非但没解开多少谜题，反而让它更加疑点重重。这里的地表到处都散落着栩栩如生的雕塑，脸上无声地凝固着痛苦的神情。

科学家们的意见发生了分歧；有些认为这些东西曾经是生物，是被一种未知的力量变成了石头。而另一些则认为它们代表了一个失落已久的文明所崇拜的神灵。更谨慎的少数人认为，这些雕像不是一种致敬，而是一种警告：对任何胆敢骚扰这颗行星的人发出严厉的警告。
texts.en:
Continued exploration of [From.GetName] has yielded more questions than answers. The surface is littered with eerily lifelike statues, their expressions petrified in silent agony.

Our scientists are divided; some believe that these forms were once living beings, turned to stone by an unknown force. Others suggest they represent deities, worshipped by a long-forgotten civilization. A more cautious few believe the statues are not a tribute, but a warning: a grim message to any who would dare to disturb the planet.

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]的进一步探索非但没解开多少谜题，反而让它更加疑点重重。这里的地表到处都散落着栩栩如生的雕塑，脸上无声地凝固着痛苦的神情。

我们的集体意识中涌出了许多关于这些雕像的不同想法，比如它们可能是被未知力量变成石头的活物，或者代表了某种古代失落文明所崇拜的神祇。亦或许这些雕像并不是致敬，而是一种警告：对任何胆敢骚扰这颗行星的人发出严厉的警告。
texts.en:
Continued exploration of [From.GetName] has yielded more questions than answers. The surface is littered with eerily lifelike statues, their expressions petrified in silent agony.

Many different thoughts flood our collective consciousness some of these forms could have been living beings, turned to stone by an unknown force. Or perhaps they represent deities, worshipped by a long-forgotten civilization. Maybe these statues are not a tribute, but a warning: a grim message to any who would dare to disturb the planet.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的地表偶然发现了一种怪异的岩石形态。需要进一步研究才能确定为何它会存在于这颗其他方面都贫瘠的星球上。
texts.en: We have stumbled upon a grotesque rock formation on the surface of [From.GetName]. Further study is needed to determine why it remains on this otherwise barren planet.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]船员的进一步调查发现，这些雕像是某种与石质类高度相似的古代物种的遗骸。曾经维持其形态的某种力量早已消散了。现在，它们暴露在自然环境中，被逐渐侵蚀成细小的灰尘，将它们的历史残余散进了[From.GetName]无情的风中。
texts.en: Further investigation by the crew of [From.GetName] has identified the statues as remnants of an ancient species bearing strong resemblance to the Lithoids. Whatever essence once held their forms together has long since deteriorated. Now, exposed to the elements, they gradually erode into fine dust scattering the remains of its history into the relentless winds of [From.GetName].

texts.zh: [From.GetName]号船员们的进一步尝试被一阵突如其来的狂风打断，这股风横扫了整个研究现场。那些脆弱的石像瞬间化为齑粉，它们曾承载的谜题也随之湮灭无痕。由于缺乏可供分析的残留证据，也无法得出明确结论，我们别无选择，只能终止此次调查。
texts.en: Further attempts by the crew of [From.GetName] were abruptly halted when a sudden gust of wind swept across the research site. The brittle stone figures crumbled into dust, erasing any trace of the riddle they once posed. With no remaining evidence to analyze and no clear conclusions to be drawn, we are left with little choice but to discontinue the investigation.
